correctness.rationale: Fernandes–Paulista Lemma 1.1 supplies that every distance-preserving partial injection of a finite cycle is a dihedral restriction, unique beyond ranks <=2 apart from even antipodal domain. A power of g|A survives h times iff some g-cycle contains a cyclic run of h selected domain points; the trace of T_h^t counts precisely the legal cyclic 0/1 words by rank. Rotation orders contribute phi(t)B_(t,h)^(n/t), reflections forbid fixed points and allow at most one vertex of each 2-cycle, giving R_n. Subtract (2n-1) empty, n(n-1) singleton, and n(n-2)/2 even antipodal rank-two duplicate extensions. h=1 treated separately. The top rank n-1 forces n-cycle rotation and one omitted vertex, count n phi(n), with index n. Independently enumerated distinct restrictions and all h for n=4..7, matching totals 41,141,307,897 and all rank/index coefficients. Finite checks do not establish arbitrary n.
